slides.say: Batching means React groups several state updates into a single re-render.
Before React eighteen, only updates in React event handlers were batched. This timeout caused two renders.

slides.text: Since React 18: timeouts, promises, native events — all batched automatically.
slides.say: Since React eighteen, updates inside timeouts, promises, native event handlers, or any other event are batched automatically.

slides.text: Need the DOM updated right now? flushSync opts out.
slides.say: In the rare case you need the screen updated immediately, flush sync lets you opt out.
